summary: Iter-63 validated the new Foundation-kind joint case flow end-to-end. Pro assessment picker on /joint/new step 3 now shows 'Foundation Statement' (data-testid=subject-foundation, label 'Foundation Statement — Each parent writes a Child-Focused Foundation Statement') and NO 'Mediation' option (data-testid=subject-mediation absent, PRO_ASSESSMENTS in JointNew.jsx replaces mediation with foundation). Creating the case yields case_code prefix 'SA-26-FND-' (observed SA-26-FND-A3FYMD) and doc.kind='foundation'. Parents are routed to /foundation?case={rid}: /dashboard button reads 'Write My Foundation Statement' with href /foundation?case={rid}; /joint/{rid}/assess client-redirects to /foundation?case={rid} (JointAssessment.jsx L78). FoundationEditor.jsx exposes [data-testid=foundation-case-share-block] with [foundation-case-share-btn] disabled until statement is complete (required fields child, shared_purpose, vision, priorities, commitments, parent_commitment); after complete save the button enables, clicking POSTs /api/joint/reports/{rid}/foundation/share (200 side='a'), toast 'Shared into your case. The professional can now see it.' shows, and the button re-labels to 'Re-share'. Professional /joint/{rid} then shows [data-testid=foundation-statements-card] with [foundation-pdf-a] href /api/joint/reports/{rid}/foundation/a/pdf and NO [data-testid=joint-print-btn] (JointReport.jsx L111 skips joint-print-btn when detail.kind==='foundation'). Backend: GET /api/joint/reports/{rid}/report returns {kind:'foundation', foundation_statements:[…]} only when both parents shared; GET /api/joint/reports/{rid}/pdf returns 400 with message 'Foundation Statement cases have one PDF per parent'; per-parent /foundation/{a|b}/pdf return 200 application/pdf containing 'Child-Focused Foundation Statement'. Sharing by only parent A leaves status=in_progress with participants.a.completed=true; parent B share flips status to 'ready' and /report returns 2 statements sorted a,b.
critical_code_review_comments: JointNew.jsx PRO_ASSESSMENTS (L14-22) no longer lists 'mediation' — parity is fine but the label 'Foundation Statement' hint says 'Each parent writes a Child-Focused Foundation Statement' which is the same wording that appears on the pro info line inside the case; consider a shorter hint since it wraps under the tile.

server.py L484 uses subject == 'foundation' to determine kind — correct today but brittle if a future multi-subject pack ever accidentally sets subject='foundation' as the primary. Consider gating on subject_keys==['foundation'] too.
server.py L703 joint_foundation_pdf still collapses invalid side and access-denied into a single 403 (same as noted iter-61/62). A 'side=c' should be 400. Non-blocking.

foundation.py share_into_case (L97-101) sets status='ready' when the OTHER side has responses, but it does not gate on the other side also having a 'foundation' entry — currently only foundation-kind cases go through this branch so it's safe, but if a future migration re-uses this branch it should require .foundation on the counter-side.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (pro picker option / case code prefix / kind, parent dashboard label + href, /joint/{rid}/assess redirect, editor share block + gated button + share + Re-share label + toast, pro foundation-statements-card + foundation-pdf-a + no joint-print-btn)
